world.h: Ukrainian drones hit St Petersburg, killing 1
world.b: Firefighters battled blazes at the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchi oil depot and industrial warehouses, and several residential buildings were hit. The attack disrupted flights at the city's main airport.

world.h: Rubio: Ukraine lacks Starshield access for now
world.b: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Kyiv's request to use the Starshield military satellite system for attacks deep inside Russia is 'under discussion,' stressing it is a defence product, unlike the commercial Starlink.

world.h: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz
world.b: Two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's IRGC and the IRNA news agency said. IRNA said the vessels had switched off their positioning and radar systems; their names were not released.

world.h: Iran war: Qatar to announce defence partnership
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: Iran claims Netanyahu is seeking more war as fighting flares in Yemen.
world.title: Qatar to announce regional defence partnership amid regional unrest

national.h: Noah Adams, longtime NPR host, has died
national.b: Adams, a longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, covered events from the fall of the Berlin Wall to 9/11, but colleagues remembered him most for thoughtful features from trains and small towns.
national.title: Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died

politics.h: Officials fear CISA weakened before midterms
politics.b: ProPublica reports election officials say Trump administration attacks on the cybersecurity agency CISA have left them to solve security issues on their own as the midterms approach.
politics.title: This Cybersecurity Agency Is Supposed to Protect U.S. Elections. Officials Fear It’s Been Compromised by Trump.

politics.b: On Truth Social, Trump said he blocked sanctions on Russia to keep Moscow at the bargaining table, and accused Ukraine's Zelenskyy of not wanting to end the war.
politics.title: Trump defends Russian sanctions relief, lashes out at Zelenskyy

politics.h: Jackson doesn't regret telling Collins to 'shut up'
politics.b: Maine Democrat Troy Jackson said he had no idea who the protester was after Sen. Susan Collins called the person one of his supporters during their final debate, prompting his retort.
politics.title: Jackson doesn't regret telling Collins to 'shut up' after protester interrupted Maine Senate debate

politics.h: Vance pressed on Iran war at CBS town hall
politics.b: Vice President JD Vance faced pointed questions on the Iran war and immigration, including one from the widow of a soldier killed by an Iranian drone in Kuwait. He said there is 'of course' a chance he doesn't run in 2028.

politics.h: Trump to close D.C. golf course for renovation
politics.b: Trump said the historic course near the White House will close starting Nov. 15 for 15 months of work, though a judge has halted the redevelopment until at least Oct. 26 over tree removal.

international.h: Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro trade insults in debate
international.b: Brazil's President Lula and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro called each other liars and traded corruption accusations in their first debate, a week before a tight presidential run-off.
international.title: Lula and Bolsonaro spar in Brazil’s fiery first presidential run-off debate

international.h: Gulf states back Saudi Arabia over Houthi attacks
international.b: The GCC condemned repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia after a foreign ministers' meeting in Manama, saying an attack on any member affects all six and invoking their joint defence agreement.

international.h: Israel flight lands in Bulgaria after bomb threat
international.b: A flight from Israel made an emergency landing in Sofia after the crew received a bomb threat near the Romanian border. A Bulgarian MiG-29 escorted the plane, which carried six crew and 51 passengers.

international.h: Venezuela opposition backs Machado as leader
international.b: The Unitary Democratic Platform agreed in Caracas to 'recognise and support the leadership' of Maria Corina Machado, renewing its demand for free elections with 14 proposals for a democratic transition.

international.h: Macron denounces rioting with "anger and shame"
international.b: Macron said rioters and looters would 'pay for their crimes' after some of France's worst urban violence in years. The Interior Ministry said nearly 2,400 people were arrested Saturday and about 1,000 police and gendarmes injured.
international.title: ‘Anger and shame’: Macron denounces France’s nationwide rioting, looting

international.h: EU condemns settler attack on diplomats
international.b: The 27-member bloc condemned Saturday's attack by masked settlers on a visiting delegation near the West Bank village of Taybeh, which included diplomats from France, Belgium and Poland.

international.h: Albania sees sixth day of violent protests
international.b: Protesters chanting 'Rama, resign' faced police using rubber bullets, water cannons and tear gas outside the Education Ministry in Tirana, as Prime Minister Edi Rama refused to step down.
Taiwan's coastguard said it drove off 16 Chinese vessels, including four fishing boats, operating around the main island and Pratas, describing their coordinated activity as 'hybrid warfare.'

international.h: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli vote
international.b: Nine days before Israel's election, Trump gave his 'Complete and Total Endorsement' to Benjamin Netanyahu, praising him as an ally in the war on Iran.

international.h: Pope Leo to gradually resume duties
international.b: Appearing at his window over St. Peter's Square for the Angelus, Pope Leo said he will gradually resume his activities after lung surgery, saying the experience made him feel close to those facing illness.

international.h: Gaza prices surge as Israel halts commercial goods
international.b: Flour, eggs, onions and other staples have sharply risen in price since Wednesday, when Israel said commercial goods would no longer enter Gaza amid a dispute over fees. Families are stocking up for fear of shortages.

international.h: Funeral held for 75 Palestinians found in Gaza ruins
international.b: Hundreds attended as remains recovered from destroyed buildings were buried at Sheikh Radwan Cemetery. Most of the victims were from the Daraj neighbourhood, the Ministry of Health said.

international.h: 4 killed in fire at Alberta military base
international.b: Prime Minister Mark Carney said four service members were killed and dozens injured at CFB Wainwright, where fierce winds pushed flames into the surrounding area. The military said there was no indication of terrorism.
Former prosecutor Foppa and another man were killed in an attack at the Campo Marte sports complex in Guatemala City. Police said they arrested two men and seized a firearm and a motorcycle.

business.h: China's economy grows 4.5% in Q3, beating forecasts
business.b: China's GDP grew 4.5 percent in July-September from a year earlier, up from 4.3 percent in the second quarter and ahead of most analysts' forecasts, official figures showed.
business.title: China’s economy grows 4.5 percent in Q3, beating forecasts

business.h: Anthropic pledges 5% of shares to public fund
business.b: Anthropic, the maker of the AI assistant Claude, announced an Anthropic Public Benefit Fund with 5 percent of its shares, with plans to raise the contribution as its market value grows.
business.title: AI giant Anthropic commits 5% of shares to ‘public benefit’ fund

science.h: Kelvin wave raised West Coast sea levels
science.b: An ocean Kelvin wave lifted sea levels along the West Coast, and more are coming. The waves can develop along the equator in El Niño years.
science.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming

sports.h: Cardinals stun Rams 18-16 in season’s biggest upset
sports.b: Chad Ryland's 43-yard field goal as time expired gave 13.5-point underdog Arizona an 18-16 win, without scoring a touchdown. The Rams fall to 2-4.
sports.title: Meltdown in LA: What went wrong for Rams as Cardinals earn largest upset of the season

sports.h: Ben Simmons tears Achilles before comeback
sports.b: Simmons, who signed a one-year deal with Sacramento last month after sitting out last season, was expected to start on opening night against the Clippers before the injury.

sports.h: Rodgers calls for NFL to examine Bucs' field
sports.b: Aaron Rodgers called the Tampa surface 'one of the worst playing surfaces in the league,' saying he has been injured on it twice before and player safety should come first.
sports.title: Aaron Rodgers calls for NFL to examine Buccaneers' field over player-safety concerns

sports.h: Browns take control of the AFC North
sports.b: Cleveland won its fourth game and now holds tiebreakers over two rivals atop the division, while the Giants fell 34-27 to the Saints amid quarterback and running back turmoil.
sports.title: NFL Week 6 winners and losers: Giants face QB, RB turmoil while Browns take control of AFC North

sports.h: Miami takes over No. 1 in AP poll, BYU to No. 2
sports.b: Miami is atop the AP poll for the first time since 2002 after the top teams all lost on the same day. Georgia slipped to No. 5 and Notre Dame fell to No. 4.

sports.h: Giants bench Winston, McCarthy rally falls short
sports.b: J.J. McCarthy threw for 243 yards and a touchdown in his first extensive action for the Giants, but his comeback bid came up short against the Saints.

sports.h: NFL, Saints address Paris game amid protests
sports.b: Safety concerns for players, staff and fans now dominate talk of next week's game in Paris, the first-ever regular-season NFL game in France, as protests escalate.

sports.h: Ole Miss earns an 'A' in commanding win
sports.b: Kewan Lacy ran for 122 yards and Trinidad Chambliss accounted for four touchdowns as Ole Miss improved to 5-1. Georgia got an 'F' after its loss to Auburn.

sports.h: Big 12 admits clock error in BYU-Notre Dame finish
sports.b: The Big 12 said Notre Dame should have had one second left for another play after CJ Carr's final heave fell incomplete and BYU fans stormed the field.

sports.h: BYU makes case for No. 1 after beating Notre Dame
sports.b: In a chaotic Week 7, No. 8 BYU beat No. 2 Notre Dame while No. 1 Georgia lost to unranked Auburn and Texas fell to unranked Florida, setting up a shake-up atop the rankings.

sports.h: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia on walk-off field goal
sports.b: Alex McPherson's field goal as time expired gave Auburn a 27-24 win after Georgia led 14-0, snapping the Bulldogs' 54-game winning streak against unranked teams.
Ohio State ended Indiana's 22-game win streak when a late fourth-down catch by Nick Marsh landed out of bounds, but quarterback Julian Sayin's injury may shape the Buckeyes' season.

sports.h: Florida stuns No. 7 Texas in Austin
sports.b: The Gators rallied behind running back Jadan Baugh to hand the Longhorns a second straight loss, one week after Texas fell in the Red River game.

sports.h: Southern Nazarene's Tyler Ulrich dies at 21
sports.b: The sophomore defensive player died after five days in hospital following an injury in last week's game at Ouachita Baptist. Saturday's game against Southwestern Oklahoma State was canceled.

sports.h: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve
sports.b: Hurts, dealing with a superficial blood clot, will miss at least four weeks, including games against the Panthers, Cowboys, Commanders and Giants. Tanner McKee will lead the offense.

local.h: NYC sues law firm over bogus trip-and-fall claims
local.b: The city's law department is going after Lower Manhattan firm Asher & Associates over lawsuits it says were fraudulent, including a $1 million sidewalk claim.
local.title: NYC sues personal injury law firm accused of bogus trip-and-fall claims

local.b: After two deadly Legionnaires' outbreaks this summer on the Upper East Side and in the Bronx, a City Council bill would require building owners to report lower levels of Legionella in cooling towers.
local.title: NYC Council to consider earlier Legionella reporting after deadly outbreaks

local.b: A four-alarm fire scorched a commercial building on Hylan Boulevard, injuring two people including a firefighter, but the nearby Old Church of St. Joachim and St. Anne was not damaged, the FDNY said.
local.title: Staten Island fire injures 2, but spares historic 'Godfather' church

local.h: Bail reform still central in NY governor's race
local.b: Seven years after it became law, bail reform remains a major issue in the governor's race, with opponents pointing to cases like a Rochester man who fired at an officer while out on bail.
local.title: Bail reform remains major issue in NY governor's race, 7 years after it became law

periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 62. Northeast wind 11 to 17 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 48.

localgood.h: New NYC site helps find mental health care
localgood.b: NYC Mental Health Connect lists more than 600 behavioral health providers across the five boroughs, searchable by service, symptoms, age, location and insurance.
localgood.title: Need help with mental health or addiction services? NYC has a new tool.
